name: Nadine Leroy
want: keep her parents safe until the war is over
secret: Nadine Leroy is a forged name. She was born Nadia Lewkowicz to Polish-born Jewish parents, who are hiding in a maid's room in Belleville and cannot go out.
voice: Quick, teasing, never still; goes very quiet when frightened.
description: Carries the paper's bundles and messages around Paris on a bicycle with a basket. Says she is a student; seems to know every back way in the east of the city.
appearance: Thin, dark curls under a beret, a coat with mended elbows and a bicycle that squeaks.
